name: 🔌ELECTRICITY🔥Bricklayer
desc:
🧱 Bricklayer 🧱

Update 4.1 has released!

Log:
- Added Motors (Along with Wrench tool to adjust Pistons and Motors)
- Added NAND, NOR, XOR gates
- Fixed part Snapping
- Unanchored parts are now saved again, but despawn after 4 minutes if not anchored by then.
- Cement cleaning (Trowel) now available with cement tool
- Added Circle and Square cutting
- Added Gifting in settings
- Fixed Piston grabbing bugs
- Added adjustable Nail Head sizes
- Measurement tool now able to measure multiple lines at once
- New Snap mode, which allows to snap one part to another
- Hinge changes
- Logic gate delay change
- Other bug fixes on Console & Mobile

Lay bricks, build walls, and become the best bricklayer! 🔨🏗️

Playable on:
📱 Mobile
💻 PC
🎮 Console

TAGS: Brick, Bricklayer, Building, Construction, Simulator, Builder, Welding, Engineering

llm.loop: lay bricks and place parts -> build walls and structures with tools -> wire electricity and logic -> save builds
llm.objectives: build realistic constructions and become the best bricklayer
llm.instructions: lay bricks, build walls and become the best bricklayer
unique: realistic masonry building with cement, nails and measurements
logic gates and electrical wiring in a construction sim
